meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 把结构化文档按用户意图拆成四张卡片:蓝卡记事实、绿卡做解释、黄卡标风险、红卡给行动;卡片尽量带来源,缺来源会标明;LLM 不可用时退化为规则引擎,并注“未启用 LLM”。结果存 JSON 文件。
howto.when: 当有人向你提供已解析的结构化文档并明确想从中得到事实、解释、风险或行动建议时触发;也可用脚本 `run_four_color_cards.py --stage extract/review/propose` 按阶段调用。

say.text: 请把这份文档生成事实、解释、风险、行动四张卡片。
say.note: 完整流程输出四色并按来源标注。

say.text: 先审查这篇材料里哪些说法是过度声明,生成黄卡。
say.note: 黄卡会标记不确定性;缺 LLM 时会注明未启用。

say.text: 跑一下 extract 阶段,把事实蓝卡存成 JSON 文件。
say.note: 对应脚本的 extract 阶段入口。

howto.what_en: Creates blue fact, green explanation, yellow risk, and red action cards from a parsed doc + user intent. Each card tries to include a source; missing sources are noted. Without an LLM, falls back to rules and flags 'LLM disabled'. Writes JSON output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a parsed structured document and wants facts, explanations, risks, or actions; also when running `run_four_color_cards.py --stage extract/review/propose`.

say_en.text: Please generate fact, explanation, risk, and action cards for this document.
say_en.note: Runs the full flow and tags sources.

say_en.text: Check this material for over-claims and produce a yellow risk card.
Run the extract stage and save the blue fact card as JSON.
